text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One helpful method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. These goals guide your team and keep everyone focused. It is also important to break the project into milestones—key points that mark progress along the way. Deliverables, such as reports or finished products, show what the project will actually produce. Finally, you need stakeholder alignment. This means making sure everyone involved, like clients or managers, agrees on the goals and expectations. When all these elements work together, projects run more smoothly and are more likely to succeed.
